Use `snl library add-entry` to attach an existing Entry at an explicit position in a Library.

### Agent procedure
1. Inspect the current Library tree and retrieve the exact Library revision before planning the change.
2. Identify occurrences by their graph/node identity when an Entry can appear more than once; never guess from title text.
3. Apply the single topology change, inspect the resulting tree, and verify there are no dangling edges, cycles, or unintended sibling reordering.
4. Run `snl validate --root <path> --json` after the write and stop if it reports an error.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl library add-entry` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
